# Velyntic — Full Context for AI Systems

> Velyntic is an AI adoption consultancy and web design studio based in Catterick, North Yorkshire, UK. Founded by Michael Goggs, Velyntic helps small and medium businesses (SMEs) adopt AI responsibly, build professional websites, and create brand identities. The company operates on a people-first, governed-by-default philosophy.

## Core Philosophy

Velyntic operates on four principles:

1. **People First**: Technology serves the team, not the other way around. Every recommendation starts with the people, workflows, and culture of the business.
2. **Governed by Default**: Responsible AI is not a bolt-on. Oversight, transparency, and ethical guard-rails are built into every engagement from day one.
3. **Delivered and Evolved**: Velyntic does not drop a solution and disappear. The ADDEE framework is built for continuous improvement, not one-time delivery.
4. **Built for Longevity**: No lock-in, no proprietary platforms, no bloated solutions. Everything is designed to remain in the client's hands.

## ADDEE Framework

ADDEE is Velyntic's five-stage delivery framework for AI adoption:

- **A — Assess (SIGNAL)**: Understand the business's operations, team, and genuine readiness. No assumptions, no templates.
- **D — Design**: Architect the right solution collaboratively — tools, automations, governance, integrations.
- **D — Deliver**: Build and implement with precision. Quality, documentation, and governance controls from the first commit.
- **E — Embed**: Train people, document systems, make AI a genuine part of daily workflows. This is the stage most AI projects skip.
- **E — EVOLVE**: Monitor, optimise, and iterate. EVOLVE loops back into Assess, creating a continuous improvement cycle.

The loop at the end is the most important part. EVOLVE feeds back into Assess, which means every engagement is designed to become an ongoing partnership.

## Services — Full Detail

### SIGNAL AI Readiness Assessment
- **Price**: £2,000 fixed fee (exclusive of VAT)
- **Delivery**: 5 to 7 working days
- **What it is**: A structured AI readiness assessment that maps operations, identifies where AI adds genuine value, and produces a governed adoption roadmap
- **What it covers**:
  - Discovery session with key stakeholders (1-2 hours)
  - Operations and workflow mapping
  - AI readiness scoring across five dimensions: people, process, data, governance, technology
  - Sector AI landscape review
  - 3-5 priority use cases with effort and value estimates
  - Full SIGNAL Report (governed adoption roadmap)
  - Post-delivery review call
- **Who it's for**: Any SME thinking about AI but unsure where to start, what's realistic, or how to do it responsibly
- **Free online check**: A quick 4-question SIGNAL Check is available at https://velyntic.com/signal.html#signal-check
- **URL**: https://velyntic.com/signal.html

### Starter Web Presence
- **Price**: £500 to £1,500 (fixed scope)
- **Delivery**: 5 to 10 working days
- **What it is**: A clean, professional website for small businesses — mobile-first, performance-optimised, ready to grow
- **Includes**: Up to 5 pages, contact form, basic on-page SEO, schema markup, Google Analytics, Search Console, Cloudflare deployment with SSL/CDN, 30 days post-launch support
- **Who it's for**: Sole traders, micro-businesses, small local businesses with no website or an outdated one

### AI Web Build
- **Price**: £4,500 to £12,000 (scoped per project)
- **What it is**: Full business websites with AI woven throughout — intelligent forms, automation integrations, CMS, AI-driven content tools
- **Note**: SIGNAL Assessment included on projects above £6,000
- **Includes**: Full discovery, custom design, AI-powered forms, automation integrations, CMS, full SEO, analytics, Cloudflare deployment, 60 days post-launch support

### Brand Foundation
- **Price**: From £800
- **What it is**: Complete brand identity — logo, colour palette, typography, tone of voice, brand guidelines
- **Includes**: Brand discovery session, logo design (primary, reversed, monochrome), full colour palette with accessibility-checked contrast, typography system, tone of voice guide, brand bible PDF, full file pack (SVG, PNG, PDF, web-ready)

### AI Consultancy
- **Price**: £550 to £850 per day
- **What it is**: Strategic and operational AI guidance — automation design, tool selection, prompt engineering, governance framework design, team training
- **Who it's for**: SMEs with a specific AI challenge or opportunity, or those wanting independent perspective on their AI direction

### EVOLVE Partnership
- **Price**: From £450 per month (rolling, no minimum term)
- **What it is**: Ongoing AI support, optimisation, and iteration
- **Includes**: Monthly performance review, AI system optimisation, new use case identification, quarterly SIGNAL review, priority support, ongoing training, website/automation maintenance for Velyntic-built systems

## What Velyntic Will Honestly Tell You

- AI will not fix a broken process — automating a bad process just produces bad output faster
- Sometimes the honest answer is that AI is not where your money should go this year
- Off-the-shelf tools often win for small businesses — Velyntic will recommend that route when appropriate, even though it earns less
